nodes.label: Material UI v9
nodes.rationale: Chosen after PHASE 7 hardening; provides shared blue-gray theme with light and dark schemes; requires Chrome 117+ and Safari 17+; native date controls retained because Date Pickers requires an additional unapproved date library

nodes.label: Scrypt Password Hashing
nodes.rationale: Standard-library scrypt with fixed cost N=32768, r=8, p=3 and a 16-byte random salt; PostgreSQL stores only the SHA-256 hash of each session token

nodes.label: CSRF Protection
nodes.rationale: Listening events carry CSRF token in JSON body rather than header because sendBeacon cannot set custom headers; all other mutations use header-based X-CSRF-Token

nodes.label: Alembic Migration Versions
nodes.rationale: Private production Alembic version schema prevents runtime application role from accessing migration metadata; development uses public schema

nodes.label: Audiveris OMR Engine
nodes.rationale: Pinned at commit 9e1e55cd2746037d059345881c53e6a6754bffbd version 5.11.0; OMR container requires exec on tmpfs for JavaCPP native libraries; 512 MiB Java heap inside 1024 MiB container limit

nodes.label: Spoken Notes Vocabulary and Clips
nodes.rationale: 66 pre-generated AAC clips served as public static assets; Web Audio clock used for scheduling (not chained timers); playback rate never drops below 1 to preserve natural voice pitch; silence fills remaining duration for short words in long notes

nodes.label: X-Accel-Redirect Protected Delivery
nodes.rationale: FastAPI returns X-Accel-Redirect header; nginx resolves through internal /_protected_media/ location; FastAPI never reads file bytes; Direct external requests to the internal location return 404

nodes.label: Release Bundle Artifact
nodes.rationale: Contains release.json with immutable image digests, deployment Compose files, and SHA-256 hashes; publication only after successful production container checks; 30-day retention

nodes.label: Product Telegram Worker
nodes.rationale: Shares backend image; uses FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED for claiming pending imports; PostgreSQL advisory lock prevents concurrent pollers; deterministic media UUID derived from Telegram update ID prevents duplicate files on retry

nodes.label: Game Player Model
nodes.rationale: FK to users.id; level computed from xp using threshold array in config.py — not stored; maps to student role; supports multiple player profiles per parent account

nodes.label: Game Round Anti-Cheat Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Server generates all 7 tasks upfront; timing validated server-side (issued_at + time_limit + grace_ms); double-tap guard returns already-stored result idempotently for same task_index; tasks one at a time prevents pre-solving

nodes.label: Game Staff SVG Renderer
nodes.rationale: Custom SVG per owner decision (not OpenSheetMusicDisplay); diatonic pitch-to-staff-position mapping; ledger lines only when needed (position < 0 or > 8); responsive via viewBox

nodes.label: AI Avatar Generation Worker
nodes.rationale: Follows OMR worker pattern with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; OpenAI moderation check before DALL-E generation; base+happy+sad variant generation; daily limit via avatar_generation_log; flagged requests not billable

nodes.label: GameTheme Child MUI Theme
nodes.rationale: Child MUI theme wrapping only /game/* routes; does not affect the rest of the app; coral primary, sunflower secondary, mint success palette; Fredoka font (Cyrillic-capable) via @fontsource/fredoka; 24px border radius; pill-shaped buttons with 3D pressed effect

nodes.label: Confusion Analytics
nodes.rationale: Kid-facing: one friendly hint per round based on top confusion; admin-facing: 7x7 heatmap expected x entered, top-3 confusions with counts, filterable by clef; aggregated in SQL with indexes on (season_id, player_id)

nodes.label: Game Web Audio Synthesis
nodes.rationale: No sample files; triangle oscillator with frequency 440*2^((midi-69)/12); 0.3s decay envelope; AudioContext unlocked on first user gesture; fire-and-forget, errors silently swallowed — never blocks input

nodes.label: VPS Rollout Script
nodes.rationale: Stops application services, runs migrations, then starts with healthchecks; compatible rollback checks previous release Alembic heads against current database before restarting; DEPLOY_DISK_INSUFFICIENT blocks before any service changes

nodes.label: PHASE 7 Hardening and Documentation
nodes.rationale: Final accepted phase as of 2026-10-01; includes storage preflight, 404 page, security headers (CSP/HSTS/frame denial), structured logs, dependency audits, and smoke checklist

nodes.label: Appearance Settings Feature
nodes.rationale: Separate feature after Material Design; migration 0007_appearance; Classic/Forest/Warm/Plum schemes; Roboto/System/Serif fonts; 16/18/20px sizes; light/dark mode remains browser-local; account preferences follow user across devices

nodes.label: Material Design Migration
nodes.rationale: Separate visual migration after PHASE 7; installs Material UI 9.4.0, Community DataGrid 9.14.0, Emotion, Fontsource Roboto; theme toggle persists locally without account settings changes; score surface stays white in dark mode; native date controls retained
